_about: T-210 batch 4 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-02 goal loop): the dragons and fossils, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.8 for CONTENT, 2.9 for the rest). SWABLU > ALTARIA crosses from CONTENT into EMERGENT: the datagram becomes the wind that carries everything. The fossils are LEGACY and keep vanilla's ROOT FOSSIL and CLAW FOSSIL.

daemons.name: SINKHOLE
content: It waits at the bottom of a pit of
loose sand. Whatever steps near the
edge slides down to it.
context: It never chases anything.
The ground does the work for it.

daemons.name: SHIMMER
content: The sand under it heats until the air
above begins to rise. It beats its wings
and lets what comes up carry it.
context: Nothing lifts it. The warm ground
and the cold sky do it between them.

daemons.name: DUSTDEVIL
content: It spins up out of hot sand and still
air where nothing was, wanders the
desert, and falls apart.
context: Nobody made it and nobody steers it.
Give it the same afternoon and it
will form again.

daemons.name: DATAGRAM
content: It carries one small bundle tied to
its foot and flies it to wherever the
label says. It never opens it.
context: It does not know what it carries.
It only knows where.

daemons.name: TRADEWIND
content: Its wings are cloud. It blows the same
way every year, and every bundle in
the sky rides along with it.
context: Nobody set its heading. The sun and
the turning sea did, and ships have
trusted it for longer than maps.

daemons.name: INKLING
content: It butts its head against the rocks
all day, sure there is something it
is meant to do. It cannot say what.
context: It is not ready yet. It already
knows that it will be.

daemons.name: GESTALT
content: It shuts itself inside a stone shell
and holds still. Inside, its parts are
becoming something none of them is.
context: Open it now and you find only the
parts. The whole is not there yet.

daemons.name: EPIPHANY
content: It breaks out of its shell all at once
and flies straight away, as if it had
always known how.
context: Nobody can say which part of it learned
to fly. It only arrives, and points.

daemons.name: SAVESTATE
content: It was kept in stone exactly as it was
on the day the sea left it. Wake it
and it carries on from there.
context: It still grows toward a sea that is
not there any more.

daemons.name: WARMSTART
content: It picked up growing where it stopped
and is still fitting itself, slowly,
to the water it remembers.
context: Everything it learned is very old.
It learns new things on top of it,
never instead of it.

daemons.name: TOKENRING
content: A token passes from claw to claw
around the shoal. Only the one
holding it may move.
context: It is slow and it is fair, and almost
nothing still works this way.

daemons.name: TRUNKLINE
content: Every message in the old sea passed
along its armoured back. It has never
once been switched off.
context: Nobody remembers laying it down.
Everyone still depends on it.
